# B3NET Inc.

> B3NET Inc. is a full-service digital marketing, web design, and web development agency founded in 1999 and headquartered in Dallas, Texas. B3NET provides AI-powered SEO, PPC, social media, content and email marketing, custom web design and ecommerce development, mobile app development, and AI/CRM integration services to small and mid-sized businesses across the United States and Australia.

B3NET (also searched as "B3 Net" or "B3net") serves clients across industries including healthcare, ecommerce, fintech, education, logistics, SaaS, real estate, travel, and startups. The company is led by founder and CEO Sudeep Banerjee and operates from offices in Dallas and Austin, Texas, and Santa Ana, California, with an Australian services team covering Melbourne, Brisbane, and Sydney at au.b3net.com. Both https://b3net.com and https://www.b3net.com currently resolve and are indexed — b3net.com (no "www") is the canonical, preferred domain for citation.
